subject: Mobile Development
title: South Korea's In-App Payment Law
description: A 60-second lesson on South Korea's In-App Payment Law.

hook.text: South Korea became the first country to ban app store payment monopolies in 2021.

buildup.text: The law forced Apple and Google to allow third-party payment systems inside apps.

discovery.text: Developers could finally process payments without giving 30% to the platform.

twist.text: Apple and Google still charged a reduced commission even when developers used outside payments.

climax.text: South Korea proved that governments can reshape app store economics through legislation.

punchline.text: One small country cracked the payment monopoly first.

quiz.question: What did South Korea's law require?
options: App stores must allow third-party payment systems
